name: brobond-erp
description: Brobond AI ERP — base principal do ecossistema BROBOND (roupas masculinas): estoque, produção e financeiro + módulo de conectores multicanal (motor do brobond-ai-commerce)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run start
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
